sloka: अनुरक्ता हि मनुजा राजानम् बहुभिर्गुणैः ।त्वाम् च माम् च नरव्याघ्र शत्रघ्नभरतौ तथा ॥२-४६-५॥
transliteration: anuraktā hi manujā rājānam bahubhirguṇaiḥ ।tvām ca mām ca naravyāghra śatraghnabharatau tathā ॥2-46-5॥

translations.english: O best of men because of our many virtues, the people (of Ayodhya) are indeed loyal to the king, to you, to me and to Satrughna and Bharata, too.
